description: A "perfect opportunity" is all that stands between Nelly and completing her task...

dialogs.text: All relevant labor regulations and procedures must be followed in the production zone — that means safety first. If you've got no questions, then don't disturb my work.
Huh? What's a Kamera doing here?
"Where there's news, there's Kameras." Have you never heard that before?
I think I have.
But I just made that up, so where did you hear it?
Well, there really isn't anything new under the sun, anyway. No matter what I say or write, it is always but a parody of others.
The Kamera is here, so where's the news?
Well... News is like fishing. It requires patience and making the right judgment at the right time. That's how you hook really big fish...
Oh! I mean... That's how you hook a scoop. Hmm? Wait, that doesn't sound right! Ugh! Forget it!
That sounds a bit amateurish. You're not a journalist, right?
Then you've misjudged me, heh. I'm an amateur journalist!
Anyway, what's an amateur journalist like yourself doing here?
I'm here to complete the project assigned to me — to capture the most vivid moments of the Fortress of Meropide guards at work with my Kamera!
But I spent too much time completing the required compliance documents... Just take a look and you'll understand.
Nelly takes out a stack of documents, all packed with various contractual clauses and signatures. Just looking at them makes you feel dizzy...
By the time I completed all the procedural paperwork, I missed the guards at work during their shift! Or in fishing terms, there aren't any fish in the water right now...
Huh? But there are guards on duty here right now.

But I want to hook a Platinum Collection. I don't think an Initial Configuration or Water Body Cleaner has enough impact... That way, even if I complete my project, other photographers might not think it worthy of praise.
Stop being so picky if you don't want to return empty-handed.
You're right. I need to come to terms with my own limited abilities, and stop trying to catch fish that are beyond me... *sob* I'm such a useless angler... Oh, wait, I mean amateur journalist.
Alright, no more wallowing in self-pity. Time to cheer up! If it's alright with you... Could you do me a small favor? Please! I'll pay you!
Whoa! That was fast... Well, it depends on the favor. So, why don't you tell us what it is first?
The guard over there, Grainville. Based on my judgment, his news value among guards is equivalent to that of a Situation Controller among maintenance meks...
I should be able to write a good report with him as my subject... Well, I can keep myself from getting criticized, at least.
But he just refuses to come over here! So, could you bring him to a suitable spot for me to take a snapshot?
Why don't you just explain it to him yourself and get him to come over that way?
Knowing about the Kamera will make him focus on it and stiffen up, that would make the photo too staged!
Let me think. It's best if we turn off the loudspeaker, report it to Grainville as a malfunction, and ask him to come have a look.
Then I'll definitely be able to capture a vivid moment of a Fortress of Meropide guard at work!
My project's completion depends on this! I'm counting on you! Please help me!
#It doesn't sound difficult, {NICKNAME}. Maybe we should help her out.
Can't you just take your Kamera over to him?
Well... The view is better here. And if he sees the Kamera, I'm sure he'll focus on it and leave me with nothing but a bunch of stiff poses to work with...
Well, you keep on waiting then. See ya!
You're just leaving? Really? Aren't you going to help me?
Well... It's not like we can just magically conjure up the Platinum Collection you want!
Never mind the news, I like fishing too.

Really? That's perfect! Actually, I'm just a novice angler, and I've got a bunch of questions but didn't know where to turn for advice. For example, if you hook a maintenance meka and it bites... What would you do?
Just release it.
I see, I see, so that's how you'd choose to handle it. Hmm, it's a very valuable reference. I will commit it to memory.
Huh!? How did we end up talking about fishing? You're really good at steering the conversation!, huh? It seems I have much to learn as an amateur journalist...
But it was you who brought up fishing!
Beat it up and show it who's boss.
Cook it for Paimon.
#Whoa! Paimon really believes in your cooking, {NICKNAME}, but no matter how you look at it, those just aren't edible!
Nope.
Oh! Well, you've heard it now! Don't forget that if you do happen to use it anywhere else, you must cite the source — namely, me!
All relevant labor regulations and procedures must be followed in the production zone — that means safety first. If you've got no questions, then don't disturb my work.
I must take a photo so good that all the other photographers will gain new levels of respect for me!
I still want the Platinum Collection though... Agh...
All relevant labor regulations and procedures must be followed in the production zone — that means safety first. If you've got no questions, then don't disturb my work.
I must take a photo so good that all the other photographers will gain new levels of respect for me!
I still want the Platinum Collection though... Agh...
Hi, we found a loudspeaker that seems to be malfunctioning... It's over there.
Again? That's strange... I just got Clynes to repair it. Looks like he's not even as good at fixing things as I am. I mean, all you gotta do is give machines a couple of good smacks, right?
Anyway, thanks, I'll go have a look.
Thanks for your help!

flow.stepDescription: Wait for the guard to reach the designated spot

dialogs.text: I've finally completed my project! I'm a journalist in my own right now! Thank you!
You must have snapped a really excellent picture.
Yeah, take a look at this.
It doesn't look very vivid, but it's artistic alright.
Paimon doesn't understand art at all...
Will it really be okay to just use this one?
What's wrong with it? I think it's a great shot! I'm sure no one would have expected me to snap a shot like this one! They will all be so surprised...
Paimon really doesn't get your standards for artistic critique...
Oh, it's called "symbolic meaning over substance." I'm sure all experienced photographers will understand once I submit it!
Anyway, thank you. This is for you. Hehe, it would be great if we could chat at a fishing spot next time!
It's so vivid it almost seems like it will start moving any moment now.
Hmm, Paimon might get dizzy if she looks at it any longer...
What's wrong with it? Hmm...
